title: The Ivory Bastion
description: These halls shelter the people who cannot defend themselves. Seren will not surrender the white bond until you prove that opening the plane is worth the risk.

title: The Tidal Archive
description: Ilyon has catalogued every failed attempt to cross the seal. The archive preserves their lessons, and its guardian demands more than a confident theory.

title: The Court of Debts
description: Veyra calls the seal a debt owed by the living to the dead. Her sentries collect their stakes through ordinary ante; there is no bargain that replaces victory.

title: The Furnace Keep
description: Rhaz tends a fire that has never felt a wind from another plane. Defeat the herald and the red bond can finally burn through its own cage.

title: The Rootbound Hold
description: Thalen remembers when these roots reached beyond Shandalar. The green bond protects the living world, but protection has become confinement.

title: The Veiled Sanctum
description: Five bonds converge here. Their guardians can name a champion, but only defeating the Veiled Warden can break the seal and make that champion a planeswalker.

title: The Academy Workshop
description: The Academy turns mana into machinery and machinery into possibility. Explore the workshop before seeking an audience; Urza judges accomplishments rather than promises.

title: Urza Unbound: The Inner Study
description: Beyond the workshop is a study unconstrained by one historical era. Its artifacts are tools, not favors from the rules of Magic. A true conquest here will be remembered.

title: The Court of a Thousand Bolases
description: Every monument celebrates the same dragon. His servants insist this is architectural consistency. Bolas permits an audience long before he considers you worthy of a challenge.

title: Bolas: The Sovereign Throne
description: The inner court contains still more tributes to its owner. Bolas has reserved his most self-aggrandizing deck for the planeswalker audacious enough to pursue him here.

title: Sarpadia: The Fractured Frontier
description: Thallids, Homarids, Thrulls and Icatians contest a dying order. Their cards share one historical set; the council guards the expedition checkpoint and its sealed reward.

title: Mirrodin: The Foundry Roads
description: Myr and scavengers travel these foundry roads. Follow their artifacts toward Lumengrid, where the archmage guards the passage into Darksteel.

title: Darksteel: The Modular Vault
description: The vault gathers fragments into greater machines. Its modular sovereign guards the next checkpoint; retreat preserves the path already earned.

title: Fifth Dawn: The Sunburst Temple
description: Five colors of mana meet beneath the new dawn. The convergence marks the end of the Mirrodin block expedition and the beginning of repeatable mastery.
